text: Bitcoin is holding near $66k with minimal losses while Ethereum has softened slightly to $1,924, suggesting modest profit-taking across the majors rather than panic selling. Fear sentiment remains elevated at 33, though it has eased 8 points over the week, indicating some recovery in buyer confidence. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.8% and volume at $70B show steady market structure without capitulation, consistent with a consolidation phase rather than a directional breakdown.
